data.comparison_basis: Cheapest published paid/production-oriented option that is approximately 4 GB RAM in a US region. Prices are monthly list-price estimates before tax, egress, I/O and optional HA unless noted. For usage-priced services, the estimate assumes continuous operation for about 730 hours/month.

providers.name: Neon
providers.monthly_price: About $77.38 compute (1 CU × 730 hours × $0.106), plus $0.35/GB-month storage and $0.20/GB-month instant-restore history
providers.included_storage: None on paid plans; usage-priced at $0.35/GB-month
providers.backup_retention_days: Up to 7 days history on Launch
providers.point_in_time_recovery: Available as instant restore, but history storage is extra at $0.20/GB-month
providers.free_tier: $0: 100 CU-hours/project/month, 1 GB Postgres storage/project, and 6-hour history window
providers.notes: Launch is the lower-cost paid option; Neon labels Scale, rather than Launch, for production-grade workloads. This is a usage estimate, not a fixed plan fee.

providers.name: Supabase
providers.monthly_price: About $75: $25 Pro subscription + $60 Medium compute − $10 paid-plan compute credit
providers.included_storage: 8 GB disk per project; additional storage $0.125/GB
providers.backup_retention_days: 7 days of daily backups on Pro
providers.point_in_time_recovery: Not included in base Pro; optional add-on starting at $100/month for 7-day PITR
providers.free_tier: $0: 500 MB database size and shared CPU/500 MB RAM; no production backup/PITR

providers.name: Render
providers.monthly_price: $55/month compute, plus $0.30/GB-month expandable storage beyond the included 1 GB
providers.backup_retention_days: 3 days on Hobby workspace; 7 days on Pro or higher
providers.point_in_time_recovery: Included for paid database instances; no separate PITR charge
providers.free_tier: $0 database compute / 256 MB RAM, but no recovery capability and not production-grade
providers.notes: For the 7-day recovery window, a Pro workspace may add $25/month; the $55 figure is the database compute price.

providers.name: Railway
providers.plan: Pro usage-based service sized to approximately 4 GB RAM
providers.monthly_price: About $60/month for 4 GB RAM continuously, before CPU, volume, egress and backup storage; Pro includes a $20 usage credit
providers.ram: Approximately 4 GB; no fixed Postgres instance sizes
providers.included_storage: None; persistent volumes are metered (about $0.1555/GB-month at the published rate)
providers.backup_retention_days: Approximately 4 weeks: four weekly full backups plus daily differentials
providers.point_in_time_recovery: Included as a feature when enabled; bucket storage/egress charges apply
providers.free_tier: 30-day trial with $5 one-time credits; not a production tier
providers.notes: Railway does not sell a conventional managed-Postgres instance plan; this is a steady-state resource estimate and CPU is extra.

providers.name: Fly.io
providers.plan: Managed Postgres Starter (nearest tier below 4 GB)
providers.monthly_price: $72/month plus $0.28/GB-month storage; exact 4 GB tier is not offered
providers.ram: 2 GB Starter; next tier is 8 GB Launch
providers.included_storage: None stated; storage is usage-priced at $0.28/GB-month
providers.backup_retention_days: Not specified on the published pricing/docs page
providers.point_in_time_recovery: Automatic backups and recovery included; retention window and separate PITR price not specified

providers.name: DigitalOcean
providers.plan: Managed PostgreSQL Standard, 4 GiB RAM / 2 vCPU
providers.monthly_price: $60/month for the 4 GiB primary node; HA requires a matching standby and approximately doubles node cost
providers.point_in_time_recovery: Included, limited to the last 7 days
providers.free_tier: No ongoing free managed-database tier; promotional credits may apply
providers.notes: The $60 figure is for a single primary; use a matching standby for a production HA deployment.

providers.name: Aiven
providers.plan: PostgreSQL Startup, 4 GB RAM per VM
providers.monthly_price: Starting at $75/month; exact US-region price varies by cloud and selected size
providers.free_tier: $0 Free plan with 1 GB RAM and 1 GB storage; single disaster-recovery backup, not a production substitute
providers.notes: Business is the higher-availability tier ($180/month starting, 4 GB minimum and 14-day PITR), but Startup is the cheapest roughly-4-GB paid option.

providers.name: Crunchy Bridge
providers.monthly_price: $70/month compute plus $0.10/GB-month storage; HA, if selected, adds another cluster node
providers.included_storage: No included storage allocation; provisioned separately at $0.10/GB-month
providers.point_in_time_recovery: Included within the most recent 10 days; extra retention can be configured, but beyond-10-day backups are not PITR windows

providers.name: Timescale (Tiger Cloud)
providers.monthly_price: Compute starts at $30/month plus $0.177/GB-month storage; exact 4 GB SKU is not published
providers.ram: Configurable within a service range up to 32 GB; no exact 4 GB SKU published
providers.included_storage: None as a fixed allocation; actual storage is metered
providers.point_in_time_recovery: Included to 3 days; longer retention is on higher tiers
providers.free_tier: 30-day free trial, not a permanent free tier
providers.notes: The $30 is a starting compute price rather than a quote for an exact 4 GB service.

providers.name: AWS RDS for PostgreSQL
providers.plan: db.t3.medium, Single-AZ, On-Demand, US East (N. Virginia)
providers.monthly_price: About $51.94 compute (published $0.0711/hour × 730); with 20 GiB gp3 at about $0.115/GiB-month, about $54.24 before I/O, transfer, CPU-credit and other charges
providers.included_storage: None; 20 GiB is the minimum provisioned General Purpose SSD assumption
providers.backup_retention_days: Default 7 days; configurable from 0 to 35 days
providers.point_in_time_recovery: Included through automated backups during the selected retention period; no separate PITR feature fee
providers.free_tier: Eligible new customers: 750 Single-AZ instance-hours/month, 20 GB gp2 storage and 20 GB automated-backup storage for 12 months
providers.notes: This is a cost-minimizing Single-AZ estimate, not Multi-AZ HA. AWS recommends its calculator for a final region/configuration quote, but I did not need to use it for this estimate.

data.calculator_summary: No provider required its calculator for the figures above. Railway, Neon, Timescale and AWS are estimates derived from published usage rates; Aiven and Crunchy Bridge publish starting prices but exact US-region totals vary by configuration.

message: Collected current published pricing/features for all 10 providers. Prices are comparable estimates for roughly 4 GB RAM, but several providers meter compute/storage separately or do not publish an exact 4 GB SKU. No provider's calculator was required; AWS, Neon, Railway and Timescale figures are arithmetic estimates from published rates.

suggestions.label: HA comparison
suggestions.prompt: Can you redo the comparison assuming production high availability (multi-node/standby) for every provider?

suggestions.prompt: Can you rank these providers by estimated all-in monthly cost for a specified database size, such as 50 GB?
